cpuid_out_of_range.rule: a basic/extended leaf above the maximum returns the data of the highest basic leaf (0x15, or 0x2 while MISC_ENABLE bit 22 is set); holes inside the range return zero
cpuid_out_of_range.source: CPU 16 (CLM-03-01-16), SDM Vol.2A CPUID "highest basic information leaf"
cpuid_out_of_range.open: leaves 0x40000001..0x4fffffff: treated like other out-of-range leaves here; the records only say there are no further hypervisor leaves

holes_within_range.source: CPU 16 (CLM-03-01-16): "Unsupported holes within advertised ranges return zero" (leaf 0xa PMU = 0; leaf 5 MONITOR/MWAIT absent)

mtrr_initial.decision: owner decision Oct 28, boot-features-plan.md (MTRRs enabled by the virtual firmware, RAM write-back, device ranges uncached); resolves Q3 second half
mtrr_initial.derivation: Ranges follow the M69 memory map (INV-03-03 CLM-03-03-69, "Guest physical range" table): 0x1000..0xa0000 conventional RAM, 0xa0000..0x100000 reserved legacy hole, L..4GiB non-RAM aperture holding LAPIC 0xfee00000, IOAPIC 0xfec00000 and virtio-MMIO 0xf0000000.., everything else RAM (including NVS and loader areas, below L and above 4 GiB). Encoding follows SDM Vol.3 11.11.2.2 (fixed-range layout, one type byte per range) and 11.11.2.3 (variable pair: base aligned to a power-of-two size, mask = ~(size-1), V bit 11). The fixed split (0-0x9ffff WB, 0xa0000-0xfffff UC) is derived from M69, NOT copied from a firmware image: no SeaBIOS/OVMF/edk2 source was fetched, so "typical firmware" values (for example WB shadow ROM in 0xc0000-0xfffff) are not claimed. Default type WB with UC variable ranges for the aperture is the minimal encoding of "RAM WB, devices UC"; variable pairs are decomposed into power-of-two blocks, so L other than 2 GiB uses up to 3 pairs (cpu_profile.uc_pairs).

disabled.meaning: SDM Vol.3 11.11.2.1: the architectural reset state. NOT selected; kept for tests that start from reset.

enabled.variable_pairs: UC for [L, 4 GiB) in power-of-two blocks (L = 2 GiB: one pair, base 0x80000000, mask 0xff80000800); L is the VM's guest RAM (M1), and when [L, 4 GiB) needs more pairs than MTRRCAP.VCNT the same map is encoded with default type UC and [0, L) in WB pairs (cpu_profile.py mtrr_state)
enabled.meaning: SELECTED. Linux reads it (kernel/cpu/mtrr/mtrr.c:587-600) and, when it reprograms, brackets the writes with CR0.CD and WBINVD (cacheinfo.c:1052-1110, 1115-1129), so CD, WBINVD, MTRR writes with TLB invalidation and the PAT interaction must all be implemented. UC RAM keeps x86 strong ordering: its accesses run one instruction at a time between full barriers (plan M2, owner decision November 2).

msrs.name: IA32_TIME_STAMP_COUNTER
side_effects: write sets the per-vCPU offset; crystal and LAPIC countdown unchanged; read = common TSC + offset
kernel: reached as RDTSC/RDTSCP, not by a WRMSR in the fetched sources
msrs.note: Linux boot sets TSC through tsc_adjust/sync only when TSC_ADJUST exists: not advertised

msrs.name: IA32_APIC_BASE
side_effects: EN/EXTD select LAPIC mode; EN clear clears CPUID.1.EDX.APIC; base moves the MMIO page; BSP (bit 8) is stored. Mode transitions that need the current value (SDM Vol.3 13.12.5, Figure 13-37), for the LAPIC chunk: x2APIC -> xAPIC (EN=1, EXTD 1 -> 0) and disabled -> x2APIC (EN 0 -> 1 with EXTD=1) are #GP; xAPIC -> x2APIC and x2APIC -> disabled are allowed (not modelled statelessly here)
source: SDM Vol.3 13.4 (IA32_APIC_BASE: BSP bit 8, EXTD bit 10, EN bit 11, base 35:12 up to MAXPHYADDR)
SDM Vol.4 Table 2-2 IA32_APIC_BASE: 7:0 reserved, 8 BSP flag (R/W), 9 reserved, 10 EXTD, 11 EN, MAXPHYADDR-1:12 base, 63:MAXPHYADDR reserved
msrs.note: Reset 0xfee00900 for the BSP (BSP bit 8), 0xfee00800 for APs: SDM default base, not stated in a CPU record. Bit 8 is R/W (SDM Vol.4 Table 2-2; KVM's reserved mask is 0x2ff and the bits above MAXPHYADDR): writable, so the BSP may write back the value it reads.

msrs.name: IA32_MISC_ENABLE
side_effects: bit 22 commits the CPUID dispatch generation (max basic leaf 2); bits 7/11/12 are fixed 0/1/1 and writes to them are ignored; INIT preserves, cold reset = 0x1801
msrs.note: A write is accepted iff every set bit is within {0,7,11,12,22}; then only bits 0 and 22 are committed and 7/11/12 read back as 0/1/1 (CPU 17).

census_flags.census: The decompressor code part has 401 BMI-class instructions (table A) with first uses of shlx, lzcnt, tzcnt, shrx, bzhi, andn (table B); in the kernel overall lzcntl x68, tzcntl x8, tzcntq x946 (encoded F3 0F BC, i.e. "rep bsf"), shlxq/shrxq x755; vmlinux .text has 1,454 BMI-class instructions.
census_flags.meaning: With BMI1 and ABM advertised, F3 0F BC executes as TZCNT and F3 0F BD as LZCNT (operand size result for a zero source, CF set for zero), not as BSF/BSR. BMI2 forms run in the decompressor. The decoder must pick the TZCNT/LZCNT meaning from the profile, not from the encoding alone.
census_flags.audience: implementers (admission/FEX BMI), owner (Q3 offers dropping BMI)

census_flags.census: wrussq x4 (vmlinux .text@ffffffff8109cf0a), xsaves64 x3 / xrstors64 x8 (XSAVES, gated on the XSAVES bit, which is clear).
census_flags.meaning: CPU 16 keeps CET unadvertised. Linux guards setup on cpu_feature_enabled(IBT/SHSTK) (K kernel/cpu/common.c:568-625) so S_CET/U_CET writes (:569-629) and WRUSS are not reached. If executed anyway: CR4.CET is reserved (#GP on set), WRUSS is #UD without CET, IA32_S_CET/U_CET are absent (#GP).

arch_get_random_seed_longs tests static_cpu_has(X86_FEATURE_RDSEED) before rdseed_long (K include/asm/archrandom.h:55-58, :27-33), so the two sites are not reached; rdrand.c:47 also clears the bit on a failed self-test. RDSEED executed with the bit clear is expected to #UD per SDM Vol.2 RDSEED (confirm in the S3 entropy chunk).

census_flags.census: clac x190 and stac x106, all in .altinstr_replacement (results.md B3).
census_flags.meaning: alternatives apply a replacement only when boot_cpu_has(a->cpuid) (K kernel/alternative.c:636); SMAP is clear, so the original NOP sites stay and CLAC/STAC never run. CR4.SMAP is reserved (the fault-model test for bit 21). setup_smap (common.c:378) does not set CR4.SMAP. If executed anyway CLAC/STAC are #UD without the feature.

census_flags.census: popcntq x36 / popcntl x30, all in .altinstr_replacement.
census_flags.meaning: POPCNT is advertised, so alternative.c:636 applies those replacements: POPCNT is executed by the kernel (bitmap/hweight paths). It is currently a refused form (class BMI in the census) and must be implemented before boot.

census_flags.census: rdtscp x19 and rdtsc x19 in .altinstr_replacement; rdtsc x112 overall.
census_flags.meaning: RDTSCP is advertised, so Linux writes IA32_TSC_AUX (K kernel/cpu/common.c:2213-2214) and may use RDTSCP for ordered TSC reads; which of lfence;rdtsc and rdtscp is applied is decided by alternatives order (LFENCE_RDTSC is also set, intel.c:570), so both must work. RDTSCP returns TSC_AUX[31:0] in ECX.
common.c:257-277 clears PCID/INVPCID when absent; CR4.PCIDE is reserved. If executed anyway INVPCID is #UD.

census_flags.census: rdfsbaseq x4, wrfsbaseq x2, rdgsbaseq x2, wrgsbaseq x4 (system class).
census_flags.meaning: Linux sets CR4.FSGSBASE on every CPU (K kernel/cpu/common.c:2290-2292) and entry code is patched to RDGSBASE/WRGSBASE; they are on every exception entry. #GP for a non-canonical source (CPU 9 sibling-path note).

census_flags.census: rdpkru x18, wrpkru x7, lkgs x2 in vmlinux text.
census_flags.meaning: All guarded by their features (common.c:385-389 UMIP, :524 PKU); CR4.UMIP, PKE, LA57, UINTR are reserved. Previous fault-model profile accepted UMIP, PKE, LA57, VMXE, SMXE and MCE writes; they now #GP.

census_flags.census: xsave64 x3, xrstor64 x8 (plain); xsaveopt64 x2 and xsavec64 x2 in alternatives; xsaves64 x3 and xrstors64 x8 in XSAVES-gated code.
census_flags.meaning: Plain XSAVE/XRSTOR with XCR0 = 7 is the path; IA32_XSS is only written under X86_FEATURE_XSAVES (K kernel/fpu/xstate.c:200-202). XSAVEOPT/XSAVEC replacements are not applied.

census_flags.census: monitor x8, mwait x9, monitorx x1, mwaitx x1.
census_flags.meaning: K kernel/process.c:884 (mwait_usable) returns without MWAIT; idle is HLT (process.c:751-755). Leaf 5 is a zero hole.

census_flags.census: rep movsb x103, rep stosb x84.
census_flags.meaning: uaccess_64.h:128-129,192-193 use ALT_NOT(FSRM)/ALT_NOT(FSRS): with the bits clear the kernel calls rep_movs_alternative (rep movsq loops) instead of rep movsb. MISC_ENABLE bit 0 is 1 (fast strings) but ERMS stays unadvertised (CPU 17). The decompressor and user space still execute REP MOVSB/STOSB.
Decompressor KASLR (K lib/kaslr.c:64; has_cpuflag) and the boot self-test (kernel/cpu/rdrand.c:24-47) execute it: typed entropy service with architectural CF; Q3 offers removal.

census_flags.census: vmcall x12, vmmcall x51, tdcall x3, pvalidate/psmash/rmpadjust/rmpupdate x11, encls x23 in kernel text.
census_flags.meaning: Linux does not recognise NatemuNatemu, so paravirtual hypercall sites are not selected. VMCALL outside VMX operation and VMMCALL on Intel are #UD; ENCLS without SGX is #UD.

The plan keeps CR4.PCE valid but the profile has no PMU, so RDPMC for any counter index has nothing to read (SDM: invalid index is #GP). Not a records conflict, an unspecified combination: implementers need a decision (CR4.PCE valid with every RDPMC #GP is the minimal reading).

Linux can switch the CPU to x2APIC through IA32_APIC_BASE (K kernel/apic/apic.c:1713-1729), after which LAPIC registers are MSRs 0x800-0x8ff; TSC_DEADLINE (not advertised) is not used, the LAPIC counts down from the 24 MHz crystal (CPU 13).
K kernel/cpu/common.c:1001-1005 reads leaf 7 subleaf 1 only if 7.0.EAX >= 1; our EAX = 0. Leaf 0xD subleaf 1 is read unconditionally (common.c:1007-1009) and returns zero.

No ARCH_CAPABILITIES, so Linux marks the family 6 model 0x3c identity vulnerable (plan row VERW); the owner boots with mitigations=off, but VERW (a descriptor-checking instruction) is still in the kernel text. IA32_SPEC_CTRL, ARCH_CAPABILITIES, PRED_CMD are absent (#GP); Linux reads them only under feature guards.

census_flags.census: serialize x7, clflushopt x4, clwb x1, tpause x1.
census_flags.meaning: All reached only through alternatives or static_cpu_has (K include/asm/sync_core.h:64); with the bits clear the SERIALIZE sync is replaced by the IRET-based path and the others stay as NOP sites.

K kernel/process.c:718-722 and traps.c:1087-1089 touch IA32_DEBUGCTL only for block-stepping (ptrace); the accepted whitelist does not contain it, so it #GPs. The plan chunk S4 (TF and breakpoints) may need it for BTF; decide there.

Not stated by the accepted records and left open in cpu_profile.json: CPUID.0x40000000 EAX, CPUID.0x80000001 EAX, APIC_BASE bit 8 write, SYSENTER_CS / FMASK reserved bits, leaves 0x40000001+, SYSENTER_ESP/EIP canonical check (taken from the SDM WRMSR text, not from the plan list "FS/GS/KERNEL_GS/LSTAR").
